title: DOW-UAP-D101, Intelligence Information Report, Unresolved UAP Report, Gulf of Oman, 2021
doc_notes: This document is an Intelligence Information Report (IIR) detailing UAP observations by a USSOF AC-130 gunship crew during a 2021 training exercise in the Gulf of Oman.

incidents.summary: USSOF AC-130 gunship aircrew observed two unidentified cold orbs stationary over a water-activated flare during a training exercise.
incidents.quote: observed two approximately four-foot diameter cold orbs between 0 to 20 feet above the surface of the water

incidents.summary: USSOF AC-130 gunship aircrew observed approximately 25 instances of UAP during a training sortie, exhibiting various formations and aggressive maneuvering.
incidents.quote: observed approximately 25 instances of UAPs viewed in IR as cold orbs
